reason: GCC 9 lacks two warning options and diagnoses integer promotions differently. Preserve conversion warnings without making them fatal only on GCC < 10; no runtime source changes.
after:
# vsomeip-build-kit: retain GCC 9 diagnostics without rejecting integer promotions.
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" AND CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION VERSION_LESS 10)
    string(REPLACE "-Wno-tsan" "" CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}")
    string(REPLACE "-Wno-inconsistent-missing-override" "" CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}")
    string(APPEND CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS " -Wno-error=conversion")
endif()
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
